leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement middleware to extract tenant context from incoming requests
Configure database queries to filter data by tenant identifier
Construct validation functions to enforce tenant-level access rules
Initialize tenant-aware service layers that isolate data operations
Integrate tenant isolation guards into existing API endpoints
Manipulate query parameters to maintain tenant boundaries across operations
Apply tenant context validation to prevent cross-tenant data exposure
lessonTitle: Build tenant level data isolation guards
